reviews.text: Very happy with our first visit to Empet Kalbakken today for teeth cleaning and broken claw removal. Super nice staff who welcomed us and who really seem concerned about the animal's welfare. Will definitely be back!
Very nice people working there. Clean and tidy place. Good help for my pet. I feel that I and my animal are well taken care of.
It always feels calm and relaxed at the clinic and everyone who works here is very nice. I feel like they are truly committed to my animals and doing the best for them.

Absolutely fantastic clinic with nice, understanding staff from the moment you walk in until you leave. I have both had my dog ​​euthanized there and had the half-old staffie of a cat that I now have followed up. All along the way, there are wonderful people who meet me, with good advice and a warm approach. They are also easy to get hold of by email and always go the extra mile.
Professional and skilled people who treat me and my animal with respect.

Lost a soulmate today. Very good follow-up, nice chat with the vet. Got answers to everything we were wondering. really feel they have a heart for the animal, which makes the experience of losing him a little easier. There is a lot of sadness in the loss of animals and it is nice to be seen as an owner. I feel confident that the kitty is better where he is now:) no more pain anymore.
Clean, nice service and professional
Great veterinarians who care about your animal!

What a place! What some people! I frantically called three other vets to get help for my cat who was extremely ill and no one could take us in until late in the day. Then I called Empet Kalbakken and they let us in right away. Wonderful staff who listened to me and were able to help right away. Several people threw themselves around and examined, listened and asked questions to find out what was wrong with my cat. They did everything they could and then some for 7 long hours but unfortunately his life could not be saved. The vet who had been with him and us throughout the day was left with us even after work hours and was with him until the very end. I am extremely grateful for the help we received here, and not least the support from the staff. I really can't praise this group enough, they were everything we needed when everything went terribly wrong. Highly recommended!
Nice and smart people!
My regular vets. Good price, efficient and get an appointment right away!

Incredibly nice people who work here. My dog ​​and I's favorite place with large premises doesn't have to sit on top of others.
My dog ​​whines and barks every time we park here. Wants to come in and get attention, which she gets to the point.
I feel like they genuinely care about my dog, lots of cuddles and attention from the animal caretakers.
The vets take the time to listen and give clear instructions.
My dog ​​goes here monthly to get a librela injection and has had surgery here for a mammary tumor.
I felt safe, they sent messages and called and kept me updated on the surgery.
Bought dry food for my cat. Expensive store.

Great people who care about my animals, once by "repairing" a cat that had a nasty gash in its groin after a fight, and another time by helping me accept that it was right to give a dignified end to a 19-year-old! Kudos to them!
Good and friendly veterinarians
Visited EMPET Kalbakken to buy cat food. Great store with dog and cat departments. Modern premises and wonderful staff who take good care of two-legged and four-legged friends. Recommended.
Nice people. Recommended!!
Skilled and friendly veterinarians. Clean, tidy and very professional. But you also pay for it. So good insurance is good to have.

This is probably the most expensive vet I have used in 12 years. I had a student and had to wait a very long time in the treatment room while she got ready and consulted. This feels like I paid for. Here the price and service were not related.
Good veterinarian
